# Seoul Crate

> Everyday essentials bought in Seoul, Korea and shipped to U.S. addresses. Prices are shown in USD and checkout is paid in USDC from a MetaMask wallet. Currently running on a test network (Base Sepolia) — no real money moves.

## Store
- Market: United States (U.S. shipping addresses only)
- Catalog: Korean retail goods (household, snacks, beauty, small electronics), prices in USD
- Fulfillment: after payment clears we buy the items in Korea and ship them to the customer's U.S. address; delivery usually takes 7–14 business days

## Payment
- Method: MetaMask wallet only — browser extension, the MetaMask in-app browser, or the deep link https://link.metamask.io/dapp/<host>
- Token: USDC (mock test token) · Network: Base Sepolia (chainId 84532) · No real payment
- Payment contract: 0x7fD9208e601c69639F6875EC24717e8476A2cCb1
- Flow: connect wallet → sign in → create order (with shipping address) → approve USDC → pay on-chain → server verification
- One-click: the [data-testid="oneclick-pay"] button on /checkout runs the whole sequence
- No wallets other than MetaMask are supported

## Machine-readable
- Key elements carry data-testid (data-product-id, data-stock, data-current-step, data-price-usd-cents)
- schema.org JSON-LD: OnlineStore (paymentAccepted) · Product/ItemList with USD offers
- API: GET /api/products · POST /api/orders · GET /api/orders · POST /api/orders/:id/verify
- Pages: / · /products/:id · /cart · /checkout · /orders · /orders/:id · /login · /signup
- Order requests accept an optional shipping object: {name, phone, address1, address2?, city, state, zip}

## Notes
- Testnet demo — no real payment and no real shipment
- Checkout progress: the data-current-step attribute on [data-testid="checkout-steps"]
